title: Automatic sprinkler system.
officialText:
The building shall be protected throughout by an approved, electrically-supervised automatic
sprinkler system in accordance with Section 903.3.1.1, except as otherwise permitted by Section 903.3.1.1.1 and as prohibited by
Section 3008.3.1.
